mainEntity.name: Can I waterproof my deck myself or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some basic deck sealing can be a DIY project, professional deck waterproofing is recommended for comprehensive and long-lasting protection. Professionals have access to industrial-grade materials, specialized equipment, and the expertise to handle complex deck structures and ensure proper application. Attempting a DIY job without the right knowledge can lead to improper application, voided warranties, and potential water damage, particularly with multi-level decks common in areas like Rockridge.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional deck waterproofing is recommended for lasting protection due to specialized materials, equipment, and expertise, preventing improper application and damage.
